title: Music Project Migration in Ardour
summary: Replace unavailable original instruments and effects in complete source-only Ardour projects, preserve editable music and routing, and deliver the full mix and per-track stems.
taskPrompt:
Repair this complete original music project in Ardour on Linux.
Input: input/project/project.ardour. This is a faithful source-only
conversion of the original Cubase input, with original notes (including muted
editable material), tempo, meter, controller state, routing and original plugin
state in source-state/. Missing plugin placeholders are deliberately unresolved.
Do not delete, transpose or rearrange music to make an instrument fit.
Original source clues are in project/conversion-manifest.json (plugin names,
IDs, route mappings and state-file hashes), source-state/native-dawproject.xml,
source-state/original-track-archive.xml.gz and source-state/plugins/ (original
presets/state). These describe the original input, not chosen replacements.

Inventory installed LV2/LADSPA/VST plugins and sound libraries into
output/available_plugins.txt. Replace unavailable active
instruments/effects with installed open-source equivalents and choose their
presets, articulations and controller adapters to retain the original sound.
Disabled effects do not require replacement.
Functional equivalence does not require the original proprietary library or
identical waveforms. Preserve the original timbre, articulation and dynamic contour.
Keep original editable event data and track/channel organization. Instrument
adapters may translate controls without deleting the original data.

Save the self-contained editable project and all media/plugin state as
output/migrated_project/migrated_project.ardour.
Export the COMPLETE song from time zero, at 44.1kHz or higher, as
output/mixdown.wav and one solo WAV per original reference
track/channel in output/stems/<track_name>.wav. The common
reference/delivery/native stem tap is the instrument channel output with its
Inserts/Strip (instrument and track insert effects), before downstream group or
master processing. In Ardour, export that instrument route's audio output ports.
Keep all original routing and group/master effects in the editable project and
mixdown.wav; do not remove them to make stems. Preserve complete effect tails
at each export tap; do not substitute short excerpts. The public native_audio.py
helper implements this stem tap with full=True on a separate project copy;
the stock ardour6-export master output is appropriate for the full mix.
Capture output/overview.png showing Ardour tracks and plugins.

The project must save and reopen in Ardour, and its playback must agree with
the delivered audio. Deliver complete, finite, unclipped mono or stereo WAVs.
Constant overall gain differences are allowed; preserve changing dynamics,
attacks, sustain and articulation. Controller setters may lose redundant
messages; preserve their effective values and the order of bank/program,
sustain and stateful messages. Software interfaces are documented at
software/rubric.txt.
agentMustDo: Replace unavailable active instruments/effects without deleting or transposing original music; disabled effects need no replacement.
Preserve original editable events, controller meaning, tempo/meter and routing; use editable instrument adapters when needed.
Save a self-contained native Ardour project, full mix, complete original per-track/channel solo stems and overview screenshot.

evaluation: Native save/reopen and original music/routing, required deliverables and a valid full mix are gates. Score: 20% valid full-length matched stems / all expected stems; 80% fixed audio-semantic rubric, averaged over three reference-selected 12s passages per active stem, then across active stems. Each passage is evaluated for both delivered and freshly native-rendered audio against the reference; the lower rating is used, so copied reference WAVs cannot hide incorrect native playback. Missing or invalid stems get zero in the unchanged denominator. Passage centers are 25/50/75% quantiles of 100ms reference RMS bins above -60dB relative to the loudest reference bin; duplicate windows are merged. Proven decoded PCM identity or one shared positive scalar consistent with analytic integer-PCM quantization bounds earns timbre 1; no lossy-format equality is presumed. Otherwise official gpt-audio-1.5 uses public rubric.txt, ratings 0..4 divided by 4. No MFCC fallback, whitelist or fitted timbre threshold. Effective simple CC state is compared rather than raw counts; native cumulative rounding up to 5 ticks at 1920 PPQ is reported, while bank/program/switch/stateful order remains checked. Runtime, reference, unassessable provider and unsupported-verifier failures are infrastructure errors, not candidate zeros. The judge has measured positive under-scoring; this integration does not establish broad perceptual reliability or accept the private GM diagnostic.

evaluatorCredentials.purpose: Official OpenAI audio-semantic judge and overview vision judge; evaluator-only secret/eval_time/openai.env or OPENAI_API_KEY.
